MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Kreg screw assortment fits my recent wood screw purchases because it offers fasteners for joining wood, provided I have a compatible pocket-hole setup.",
    "That kit reflects my interest in practical fastening supplies, although it was the only recommendation I would choose now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Electrical tape, grinding discs and cutting wheels involve different tasks from fastening wood or mounting fixtures; being workshop supplies does not give me a reason to buy them.",
    "The hose fitting and threaded casters require a specific project and matching dimensions that my recent purchases do not establish.",
    "The electronics organizer, precision indicator stand, thermometer and grooming brush do not address a current need shown by my recent purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying construction fasteners seems to have been taken as interest in almost any tool or workshop accessory.",
    "My occasional household purchases seem to have been stretched into interest in unrelated maintenance supplies without a clear task connecting them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated nail and wood screw purchases make fastening and wood construction more relevant than metalworking or electronics.",
    "Compatibility matters: nail angle, screw dimensions and the required fastening setup can determine whether an otherwise related item is useful.",
    "I need a present use for an item; a possible future project is not enough to justify specialty equipment or a large pack of consumables."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my fastening needs but mostly broadened them into unrelated workshop tasks."
}
